items.exampleEn: According to the news, the train leaves at nine.
items.exampleZh: 根據新聞報導，火車九點出發。

items.exampleEn: We stayed home because of the rain.
The farther you walk, the more tired you get.
My house is the farthest from the office.
This is the furthest point we reached on the hike.
items.exampleZh: 這是我們健行到達的最遠點。

items.exampleEn: I drank tea instead of coffee this morning.
items.exampleZh: 我今天早上喝茶，沒有喝咖啡。

items.exampleEn: You ought to rest more after work.
I used to walk to school every day.
items.exampleZh: 我過去每天走路去學校。

items.sentenceEn: I used to drive to work. Now I take the train instead of driving.
items.sentenceZh: 我過去開車上班。現在我改搭火車，不再開車了。

items.audioEn: According to the weather report, it will rain tomorrow. We ought to stay indoors.
items.audioZh: 根據天氣預報，明天會下雨。我們應該待在室內。

items.sentenceEn: I used to live in a small town, but now I live in the city.
items.sentenceZh: 我過去住在小鎮，現在住在城市裡。

items.sentenceEn: Farther from the city, the air is cleaner and the noise is quieter.
items.sentenceZh: 離城市越遠，空氣越清新，聲音越小。

items.stemEn: We canceled the picnic ____ the heavy rain.
items.stemZh: 因為大雨，我們取消了野餐。

items.stemEn: You ____ finish that report before Friday.
items.stemZh: 你應該在星期五前完成那份報告。

items.passageEn: Last year, I used to live far from the office. I took the bus every morning, but because of traffic, I was often late. According to my manager, I ought to find a better way to go to work. So I moved closer to the office instead of taking the bus. Now I walk ten minutes to work. The air is cleaner and the noise is quieter. I used to be stressed every morning, but now I feel much better. I think I made the right choice.
items.passageZh: 去年，我住得離辦公室很遠。我每天搭公車上班，但因為塞車，常常遲到。根據主管的建議，我應該找更好的通勤方式。所以我搬到離辦公室比較近的地方，不再搭公車。現在我走路十分鐘就能到公司。空氣比較清新，聲音也比較小。我過去每天早上都很緊張，現在感覺好多了。我想我做了對的選擇。

questions.questionZh: 根據文章，他過去常常遲到的原因是什麼？

items.promptZh: 因為天氣太冷，他過去常常待在家裡，現在他改用運動代替。
referenceEn: Because of the cold weather, he used to stay at home, but now he exercises instead.
Because of the cold weather, he used to stay home. Now he works out instead.
rubricZh: 正確使用 because of 引導原因
正確使用 used to 描述過去的習慣
正確使用 instead of 表達替代關係

items.instructionZh: 用 farthest 寫一個句子，描述某個地方或某個人離你或某個地點最遠。
referenceEn: The farthest I have ever traveled is the mountains in the north.
My grandmother's house is the farthest from the city center.
Of all my friends, the farthest one lives in another country.
rubricZh: farthest 使用正確，語法通順
句意清楚，能辨識最遠的對象
字數控制在 5 到 18 詞之間
